author: Mark Atwood
text: Superseded by JMAP-826m.55 (migration epic). Per workspace AGENTS.md '>3 files = file an epic, get approval before touching code', the actual migration work has been decomposed into a per-batch child plan and routed through human authorization on the new epic. The 24-hour stale-recommendation ratification on this bead establishes the DIRECTION (option (i): migrate to tests/, delete MockBackend) but the implementation is a substantial multi-file refactor that needs its own approval step on the epic itself.
